privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Thank you for visiting ToolOrbit. Your privacy is our highest priority. This Privacy Policy describes how we handle information on our platform, specifically emphasizing our 'local-first' data processing philosophy.

1. Zero Data Collection on Tool Usage

Unlike many other platforms, ToolOrbit processes your data (such as JSON code, images, or document uploads) entirely client-side. This means the actual content of your files never leaves your computer and is never transmitted to or stored on our servers. We believe that your private workspace should remain strictly private.

2. Google Analytics & Visit Data

To improve our service and user experience, we use third-party analytics (Google Analytics) to collect anonymous visit metrics. This includes data such as page views, browser type, and general geographic location. This data is not linked to any personal identity.

3. Advertising Policies (Google AdSense)

We use Google AdSense to serve advertisements. Google and third-party vendors use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to our website or other websites. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Ads Settings.

4. Contact & Personal Info

If you choose to contact us via email, we will only use your contact information to respond to your inquiry. We will never sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

5. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices. We encourage you to review this page regularly.

about.title: About ToolOrbit
about.content:
ToolOrbit was born from a passionate group of developers' pursuit of clean, high-performance web utilities. In our daily coding, writing, and design workflows, we often felt frustrated: many online small tools are cluttered with intrusive ads, pop-ups, and forced uploads of sensitive data to unknown backends. This not only hampers efficiency but also poses significant privacy risks.

Our Vision: Privacy as a Right

We are dedicated to building a Client-Side First online tool matrix. This means: your data, every line of code, and every private photo are processed within your own browser's sandbox. Data never crosses the network; privacy is never compromised.

Professionalism & Sincerity

Every tool on ToolOrbit is carefully crafted using modern web technologies (like WebAssembly, Canvas, and DeepSeek AI) to ensure maximum speed and precision. We are not just 'moving code'; we are redefining the online tool experience.

Why Trust Us?

  • 100% Free & No Pop-ups: We insist on an optimal user experience without ads blocking your view.
  • Technical Transparency: Core logic is clearly visible locally; you can audit our network requests anytime via DevTools.
  • Continuous Evolution: We launch new tools weekly based on community feedback, striving to be your digital 'Swiss Army Knife'.
